verdicts.reason: A keeps the '& Baby Toddler BEDDING' lockup intact but crams it and the thin image strip into the top quarter, leaving about 70% of the canvas as empty navy with stray dot grids floating in it; the headline is also small for a 300x600 format. B spreads the elements down the canvas and makes BEDDING large, but it splits the lockup so BEDDING floats far from 'Baby Toddler'. It also leaves the ampersand group pushed right and off-axis, and the dot grids crowd the image strip and the right edge; still, it reads top to bottom and uses the space better.
